content:
Directive Consulting is a premier performance-focused B2B marketing agency. It specializes in pipeline generation, revenue acceleration, and customer acquisition. These services are specially meant for SaaS, technology, industrial, and professional service companies. Directive Consulting is best known for being a leader in the “Customer Generation” method. It is a revenue-first framework designed to align marketing execution directly with a qualified pipeline. Garrett Mehrguth and Tanner Shaffer founded the agency.

How does Ignite Visibility work?

Directive Consulting works with a Customer Generation framework. It is a multi-surface marketing method designed to connect brand discoverability with the sales pipeline and revenue generation. The agency's integrated operational method includes:

  • Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and Account Universe Mapping- Directive Consulting finds high-value target accounts. It does so by using first-party CRM data, buyer intent signals,s and account-based segmentation. 
  • Financial Forecasting and Revenue Modeling- It connects marketing performance directly to pipeline revenue. For this, Directive Consulting uses predictive analytics, CAC modeling, and revenue forecasting frameworks. 
  • Multi-Surface Discoverability Optimization- Directive Consulting optimizes brand visibility on paid search, organic search, review platforms, and AI-driven discovery channels. In turn, it increases B2B buyer engagement. 
  • Pipeline-Focused Performance Execution- The platform's campaigns are structured around getting qualified pipeline and revenue. 
  • Scalable B2B Demand Generation- Directive Consulting combines AI-powered analytics, cross-channel execution, and data-driven targeting. In turn, it helps businesses reduce wasted ad spend, improve acquisition efficiency, and scale long-term demand generation systems.

Core Capabilities Powering Directive Consulting

Paid Media and Search

Directive Consulting uses high-intent Google Ads, Bing Ads, and account-based advertising campaigns.

Revenue Operations

It specializes in CRM attribution, lifecycle tracking, and sales-marketing alignment.

Programmatic and Paid Social

The agency works on precision B2B targeting on LinkedIn, display, and native advertising channels.

SEO and Content Marketing

Directive Consulting implements customer-led organic growth strategies. They are optimized for buyer intent. 

Marketplace Optimization

It enhances visibility across G2, Capterra, and the Cloud marketplaces. 

Performance Creative

The platform offers high-converting landing pages, ad assets, and conversion optimization systems.

What makes Directive Consulting stand out?

  • Revenue-first “Customer Generation”- Directive Consulting works on a Customer Generation framework. It emphasises on pipeline closed-won business. 
  • Proprietary Stratos AI- It has a Proprietary software named Stratos AI for predictive marketing intelligence and attribution tracking. 
  • DiscoverabilityOS™- The platform uses a DiscoverabilityOS™ method. This increases visibility across search engines, AI platforms, and software marketplaces. 
  • Flat-retainer pricing- Directive Consulting has a flat-retainer pricing structure that removes incentives to inflate ad spend.
  • Deep Specialization- It specializes in B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, and complex sales-cycle industries.

Key Services

  • Paid Media Management- Directive Consulting is an expert in paid media management. They work on Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and programmatic campaign execution. 
  • Account-Based Marketing- It works on precision targeting of enterprise buying committees and strategic accounts.
  • Revenue Operations- The platform executes CRM automation, attribution modeling, and lead-routing infrastructure. 
  • Search Engine Optimization- Directive Consulting provides a diverse range of SEO services, including technical SEO, content strategy, and non-branded organic traffic growth.
  • Generative Engine Optimization- It optimizes visibility within AI-driven search and answer engines. 

Advanced Capabilities

  • Predictive Revenue Modeling- Directive Consulting has an AI-powered forecasting tied to CAC, LTV, and pipeline performance. 
  • CRM Data Unification- It connects to leading CRMs. Some of them include Salesforce, HubSpot, SEO, and paid media data in one system.
  • Generative Engine Optimization- The platform structures content for discoverability across large language models and AI search engines.
  • Technographic Targeting- It maps target accounts based on software stack and intent signals. 
  • Multi-Surface Marketplace Optimization - The platform manages visibility and bidding strategies across B2B aggregator ecosystems. 

Who should work with Directive Consulting?

  • B2B Saas and Technology Companies scaling product demos, free trials, and recurring revenue. 
  • Mid-Market and Enterprise Organizations working on large account-based marketing programs.
  • Funded Startups and High-growth companies making scalable go-to-market systems

Best-fit Industries

  • Telecommunications and Infrastructure 
  • FinTech and Cybersecurity 
  • SaaS and Enterprise Technology 
  • Industrial and Manufacturing
  • Professional Services

Key Use Cases

  • Scaling Paid Media Without Historical Benchmarks- Directive Consulting builds forecasting models without new campaigns and territories.
  • AI Search Visibility Optimization- It increases discoverability within the generative AI search ecosystems.
  • Non-branded Organic Growth- The platform captures upstream buyer-intent searches beyond branded traffic.
  • Conversion Rate Optimization- Directive Consulting improves landing page performance without full-website redesigns.
  • Marketplace Domination- It improves visibility and conversions on G2, Capterra, and Software Review platforms.

Pros

  • Multi-surface optimization on search, AI engines, and review marketplaces
  • Strong alignment between marketing execution and revenue generation 
  • Advanced AI-driven forecasting and attribution Infrastructure 
  • Deep expertise in B2B SaaS and enterprise marketing environments

Considerations 

  • Larger onboarding periods due to CRM auditing and RevOps setup 
  • Premium pricing structure compared to smaller B2B agencies 
  • Best suited for mid-market and enterprise organizations with larger budgets 
  • Needs major collaborations and CRM integration from internal teams

Top Alternatives

  • Single Grain- Ideal for B2B Saas Growth and AI-first performance marketing 
  • Straight North- Impressive lead generation, call tracking, and conversion-focused PPC
  • Victorious- Best in SEO-only engagements and technical organic growth

Top Alternatives to Consider

  • MarketJoy- Specializes in multi-channel B2B lead generation services
  • GrowthSpree- Exceptional revenue-focused growth marketing.
  • NoGood- Impressive product-led growth experimentation
  • Refine Labs- Ideal Demand generation and pipeline-focused B2B marketing strategies 
  • Ironpaper- Best Industrial and enterprise account-based marketing
  • Kalungi- Expert in go-to support for early-stage SaaS companies

Final Words

Directive Consulting is one of the best revenue-first B2B growth agencies. It is designed specifically for companies with complex sales cycles and high-value customer-acquisition models. The platform combines customer generation, AI-powered forecasting, and RevOps Infrastructure. 

Do you know any businesses looking to connect marketing execution with revenue outcomes? Directive Consulting can offer a highly strategic, data-driven, and performance-oriented partnership model.
